systems.name: Ubuntu Touch
systems.notes: Official port (miatoll). Needs the stock Android 10 firmware underneath.

modem.notes: mobile data works; SMS not tested; UBports lists calls as working

systems.name: postmarketOS
systems.notes: Unsupported variant: needs a U-Boot match patch and upstream tqftpserv. No charger driver: charges at about 0.75 A once the excalibur device tree makes the USB-C port dual-role (devicetree/). The ultrawide (GC8034 units) and macro cameras work, with an excalibur device tree (devicetree/), a qcom-camss fix and a ported GC8034 driver (camera/). Call audio untested.

gpu.notes: freedreno, firmware `a630_sqe.fw`, `a630_gmu.bin`; Phosh and WebGL render on the Adreno

modem.notes: data works with upstream `tqftpserv`: LTE, IPv4 and IPv6, ~28 Mbit/s down, reconnects after reboot; SMS works both ways; calls connect, call audio not tested (`q6voiced` is probably needed)

audio.notes: speaker works, quiet (TAS2562 amplifier); microphones, earpiece, headphones not tested

charging.notes: charges from a USB-C charger at about 0.75 A once the device tree makes the USB-C port dual-role (with the stock tree, only USB-A sources reach the charger, slowly); no charger driver, so no fast charging and no charging status

usb.notes: USB networking and SSH work (tested with the stock source-only port, not yet with the dual-role tree); dual-role with the excalibur device tree

cameras.notes: the 8 MP ultrawide on GC8034 units and the 5 MP macro work; main, depth and front don't

sensors.notes: sensor service runs; rotation not tested

gps.notes: the family's postmarketOS wiki lists them as not working
